chand-madhu-set.title: Chand Madhu Set
chand-madhu-set.ground_text: chand madhu set chand means moon, and the round spice box at the heart of this set takes its name from the shape: a glass lid over steel compartments, on a wooden base. the spice box comes with two spoons. a brass ghee pot with a ladle sits alongside it, in a matte gold finish. the steel and brass are finished in matte, silver against gold, with the warm brown of the wood between them. dimensions: spice box - l15 x w15 x h4 cm & ghee pot - l6 x w6 cm gold

dhaara-fruit-bowl.title: Dhaara Fruit Bowl
dhaara-fruit-bowl.ground_text: dhaara fruit bowl a wide bowl with a fluted edge that folds like a flower, with the dhaara ripple pressed into the base. ceramic in a matte gold finish. deep at the centre and open at the rim, keeping fruit visible rather than buried. gold

fable-top-black-charcoal.title: Fable Top - Black & Charcoal
fable-top-black-charcoal.ground_text: fable top - black & charcoal the fable top leans into an easy winter mood, white and black coming together in a palette that feels calm, clean, and quietly expressive. crafted in recycled poly-wool, it’s designed in a loose, effortless silhouette with a puff flower appliqué placed at the centre back. at its core sits an embroidered circle, a small but thoughtful detail that gives this simple piece a memorable finish. black & charcoal

hornbill-shirt-indigo.title: Hornbill Shirt - Indigo
hornbill-shirt-indigo.ground_text: hornbill shirt - indigo rajesh pratap singh set out to make a shirt that carries as much craft as it does ease. the hornbill is what that looks like. crafted in 100% cotton denim. the kind of fabric that gets better with every wash. structure on day one. character by year three. the details are the point. graded pin tucks run down the front panels. a signature of the rajesh pratap singh studio. precise and quietly laborious. fagotting at the seams. kantha stitch worked through the cloth. three techniques that each take time. worn together without announcement. the collaboration mnemonic logo is embroidered at the front side panel. part of the pratap x nicobar ss26 collection. named for the nilgiri hornbill. unhurried. deliberate. entirely at home in the canopy. style it with: the linen or denim pyjama pants for a head-to-toe ease. the tahr or gaur bandhgala over it when the day asks for more. a piece built for daylight. comfortable staying out past it. indigo

ibex-trousers-sand.title: Ibex Trousers - Sand
ibex-trousers-sand.ground_text: ibex trousers - sand the ibex trousers, from the rajesh pratap singh x nicobar collection, are day trousers in sand linen, named for the ibex, the goat that climbs where others do not. 100% linen in a bottom weight, heavier than shirting linen, piece dyed in a natural beige called sand. solid, long, and cut for the office as much as the weekend. sand

marpeta-dupatta-cotton-silk.title: Marpeta Dupatta - Cotton Silk
marpeta-dupatta-cotton-silk.ground_text: marpeta dupatta - cotton silk the marpeta dupatta brings that feeling to sheer gold metallic tissue with a fine woven stripe. made in metallic tissue, it is free-size and light enough to layer over any festive kurta. wear it over teal, purple or pink for wedding lunches and diwali evenings. gold

meher-potli-violet.title: Meher Potli - Violet
meher-potli-violet.ground_text: meher potli - violet a violet potli scattered with heart-shaped mirrors, each held in place by jali thread work in a different colour. a black-and-white check drawstring gathers the top into a ruffled edge, finished with berry-toned beaded tassels. made for the wedding season, from haldi and mehendi to the cocktail evening. violet

saanjh-shawl-chartreuse.title: Saanjh Shawl - Chartreuse
saanjh-shawl-chartreuse.ground_text: saanjh shawl - chartreuse a chartreuse shawl with gota flowers and leaves worked into the corners, and a fine gota border along the edges. woven in 100% wool, with small sequin accents and tassels at the ends. saanjh means dusk, and the colour is meant to glow like it. chartreuse

tarang-bar-gift-set-glass-decanter-set-o.title: Tarang Bar Gift Set - Glass & Decanter - Set of 3
tarang-bar-gift-set-glass-decanter-set-o.ground_text: tarang bar gift set - glass & decanter - set of 3 tarang, for a wave, inspires the fine vertical flutes cut into the height of each piece. a decanter and two whisky glasses, all with a blush tint settling at the base. the flutes catch and throw light down the sides as each glass is lifted. dimensions: whiskey glass - 8.5 x 8.5 x 8 cm, decanter - 8.5 x 8.5 x 18 cm clear

veranda-tea-set.title: Veranda Tea Set
veranda-tea-set.ground_text: veranda tea set veranda is where the house meets the garden, and where tea gets poured. this set brings sixteen pieces to that table: two sets of four cups and saucers, one with glass cups and one in bone china. a palm is printed in green on the cups and saucers, with a green border on the saucers. the glass cups have a glossy finish, and the bone china cups a matte one. the cup and saucer are a new shape for the brand. dimensions : cup - d6.2xh9.6 cm, plate - d12.1xh2.2 cm, cup - d6.1x8 cm & plate - d13xh2cm multi

weekend-trousers-black-charcoal.title: Weekend Trousers - Black & Charcoal

bug-bracelet-gold-1.title: Bug Bracelet - Gold

chandni-necklace-large-gold.title: Chandni Necklace Large - Gold
chandni-necklace-large-gold.ground_text: chandni necklace large - gold there is a special kind of confidence that comes with pearls. a little old-world charm, a little modern ease, and that feeling of being exactly where you are meant to be. the chandni necklace large holds that mood beautifully. wear it when the morning turns into a ceremony and the ceremony turns into a dance floor. on its own or layered, it always finds the light. a classic string of pearls with a single garnet wink at the centre, crafted in brass and dipped in gold. quiet, elegant, and just the right touch of playful. comes in a gift box.
